title: Fruition

inlines.v: FRUI'TION, noun [from Latin fruor, to use or enjoy.] Use accompanied with pleasure, corporeal or intellectual; enjoyment; the pleasure derived from use or possession. If the affliction is on his body, his appetites are weakened, and capacity of fruition destroyed.
